MLI.note: SIM identification against the NINA is not an online authentication, e-signature or PKI service.
Nothing on civil register and ID links.
No enrolment count or share given.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
Only SIM identification, which is for the idverification study.
Nothing on the ID system's issuing, biometrics or certification.

facts.fact: Mali's telecoms regulator AMRTP decided that mobile operators identify SIM cards on presentation of the national identification number (NINA) from 1 February 2023, and Orange Mali asked customers in late July 2024 to come to an agency with their NINA or biometric card.

MLI.note: A consumer forum on SIM identification, not a consultation on a named digital law or policy.
Nothing on African regional digital bodies.
